title: Introduce robustness-signal-fusion CI gate and backfill runner
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Our existing CI eval gates are brittle when individual metrics jitter independently (semantic similarity, token-overlap, calibration). This PR introduces a robustness signal fusion layer that combines orthogonal eval metrics into a single, tunable gate signal and integrates it into the CI pipeline. The fused signal reduces false positives from single-metric noise and enables per-prompt-set sensitivity controls. What this PR implements: 1) robustness/signal_fusion module: implements a configurable aggregator that ingests multiple metric streams (semantic-similarity, length-stability, calibration-gap, perplexity-delta, token-overlap) and outputs a composite z-scored signal with tunable weights and smoothing window. 2) ci/gates/robustness_gate: a CI hook that evaluates the composite signal against cohort-level thresholds and emits a deterministic pass/fail with diagnostic score breakdown. 3) backfill runner: ability to backfill historical eval results and recompute fused signals (used for threshold calibration and retrospective triage). 4) adapters: shims to convert existing eval outputs into the fusion input format (JSON lines schema) so this gate can be dropped into current pipelines with minimal changes. 5) dashboard metadata and trace tags for per-prompt-set explanations and top-contributing metrics. Checklist: - [x] core aggregation algorithm and unit tests - [x] CI hook and integration tests - [x] backfill runner and sample backfill job - [x] docs (README + gating configuration examples) - [x] metrics/tracing tags added - [x] reviewer feedback addressed Breaking notes: non-breaking for consumers that don't enable the gate; opt-in via repo ci config. Rollout plan: land on main behind a feature flag, run backfill on the last 90 days, propose thresholds based on 95% historical percentile, then flip gate to warn-only for 2 weeks before hard-failing PRs. Related: builds on prior eval work around cohort sampling and stability anchors (references: ENG-2742, DEV:cohort-prioritizer).

review_comments: Owen Patel: The aggregation math looks sound but we should add a deterministic tie-breaker for identical scores across cohorts; otherwise golden path flaps. Please add a stable sort key (e.g., prompt_set_id + seed).
Maya Chen (author): Added stable sort key and deterministic tie-breaker in the latest commit (0a1b2c3). Also expanded unit tests to cover ties.
Lina Gómez: Can we expose per-metric contribution percentages in the gate output so SRE can triage which signal triggered failure?
Maya Chen (author): Added breakdown field to the gate diagnostics and dashboard metadata; examples updated in docs/ci/robustness_gate.md.
Arjun Rao: CI runtime impact? Running the fused gate on large cohorts might be expensive. Suggest incremental computation and caching of metric z-scores.

Maya Chen (author): Implemented a lightweight caching layer keyed by (model, prompt_set, metric_window) and added backfill-run costs to docs. Backfill runner supports chunked replays to control memory/cpu.
release_notes: Add a fused robustness CI gate that combines multiple evaluation signals into a single, tunable gate. Opt-in behind ci.feature.robustness_fusion. Includes backfill runner to calibrate thresholds from historical data.
notes_for_ops: Backfill recommended: run backfill_runner --window 90d on a staging dataset to generate threshold recommendations before enabling gate as hard-fail. Monitor metric: eval.robustness_fusion.compute_time and eval.robustness_fusion.cache_hit_rate.
example_usage_snippet:
ci_config:
  gates:
    - name: robustness_fusion
      enabled: false
      params:
        weights: [0.4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.1, 0.1]
        smoothing_window: 5
        fail_threshold: 2.5
      backfill_suggest_threshold: true
